与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:本的经历、感受与成长。
Ben's dream job is to be a doctor. Ben is saving money to buy a ticket to Paris. There are always more possibilities than we expect. There are dark clouds in the sky.

The forest path looked quieter than usual that evening. Ben keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. The green hill has become an important part of daily life. Also, she studies marine ecology at university.

On Wednesday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. The hosepipe uncoils across the lawn.
Little by little, things began to change. Amy always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The children made castles in the sand.
Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The experience taught Ben more than any book could. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
